description.content: Comments allow integrations to read and create comments on pages and blocks within Notion. Comments support rich text content and are associated with discussion threads.
Retrieves a list of unresolved comments from a page or block. Requires the integration to have read comment capabilities.

query.description: (Required) The ID of the block or page to retrieve comments for.
Pagination cursor to continue fetching results.
Maximum number of comments to return (max 100).

description.content:
The Notion API allows developers to integrate with Notion workspaces programmatically. Build integrations that connect Notion with other tools, automate workflows, and manage workspace content including pages, databases, blocks, users, comments, and search. Notion is an all-in-one workspace that combines notes, tasks, wikis, and databases into a flexible, collaborative platform.
